pattern.description: Centered two-line value statement builds word by word: each word fades in light grey (rising a few pixels) and darkens to black, while the centered block re-centers and wraps onto a second line as words are added.
pattern.why_premium: Word-paced reveal mirrors the voiceover cadence, and the grey-to-black settle plus the small rise give each word a soft landing; the live re-centering keeps the block balanced throughout.

build_hint.gsap: Split into words; tl.fromTo(words, {opacity: 0, y: 6, color: '#b5b5b5'}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, color: '#111', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.2}); use Flip on the line container so the centered block re-centers smoothly as each word lands.
build_hint.remotion: Per word i: start = i*6 frames at 30fps; opacity = interpolate(f-start, [0, 4], [0, 1]); translateY = interpolate(f-start, [0, 8], [6, 0], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); color = interpolateColors(f-start, [0, 10], ['#b5b5b5', '#111']); layout offset smoothed with spring({damping: 200}).

notes: Same typographic system as e010 (question card). The small upward drift is inferred from the filmstrip and may instead be line reflow; code should measure. No SFX candidates; camera.move none.
